anomalies: obsolete_loose - obsolete_strict = 0 in this family: the only Obsolete hit (FastenerType.md:12) is the canonical line-anchored 'Obsolete. Superseded by ...' form, so none of the 'Obsolete for documents created in ...' / 'Obsolete and not superseded' variants appear here.
FastenerType.md is an obsolete stub with no `## Returns` section at all; its signature still shows `{get; set;}` even though the NOTE above it says Set is not implemented.

IGetSketchPoints returns type `SketchPoint` (the in-process pointer style) but its `## Returns` reads only 'Array of center-hole [[sketch points]]' and carries NO literal 'in-process, unmanaged C++' string - by criterion C it is therefore NOT counted as a pointer member, even though by naming convention it is one. This is the one genuinely ambiguous call in the family.

ISetFeatureScopeBodies takes `ref Body2 BodyArr` (a ref array parameter) but the literal pointer string never appears on the page, so it contributes nothing to C or D; criterion D is defined by the literal string only and is 0 for the whole family.

Six pages have no `## Returns` section: FastenerType, InitializeHole, ISetFeatureScopeBodies, ReleaseSelectionAccess, RestoreDefaultValues, SetEndConditionReference - so of the 5 zero-arg methods, only 3 have any Returns text at all.

13 pages carry a 'get-only property. Set is not implemented' NOTE while the Signature line still shows `{get; set;}` (Face, FarSideCounterSink, FastenerSize, FastenerType, FastenerType2, HeadClearanceType, IFace, IVertex, NearSideCounterSink, Standard, Standard2, Type, Vertex) - signature shape alone does not tell you whether a set exists.

FarSideCounterSink.md says 'Gets whether the far side option is selected' and carries the get-only NOTE, yet its signature is `System.bool FarSideCounterSink {get; set;}` - no Remarks section explains the missing set, unlike NearSideCounterSink which does.

Six pages render the NOTE with four asterisks (`****NOTE:** ...`) instead of three - Face, FarSideCounterSink, IVertex, NearSideCounterSink, Type, Vertex. Cosmetic markup defect, does not affect any count.

Cross-reference links in CounterDrillAngle, CounterDrillDepth, CounterDrillDiameter and DrillAngle point at a misspelled interface `IWizardHoleFeaturData2` (missing 'e') - a source-side typo, not a member of this family.
MidCounterSinkDiameter.md uses single-colon wiki links (`[[IWizardHoleFeatureData2:CounterSinkAngle Property]]`) while every other page uses double colons (`::`).
IFace.md declares `Face2 IFace {get; set;}` but its `## Returns` text is just `[[Face]]` - the Returns prose is generic across Face/IFace/Vertex/IVertex and gives no discriminating information.

Not one of the 61 property pages states a unit for any double-valued quantity (Diameter, ThruHoleDepth, DrillAngle, CounterSinkAngle, ...). Any claim about metres vs millimetres for these must come from measurement or from another source, not from these pages.

InitializeHole.md's parameter is spelled `FastnerType` in the official source (missing 'e'); it is a void method with no `## Returns` section and 5 parameters, so it is in none of the counted buckets.
